name: Bot
tagline: Fast, modular server management bot with premium AI features
changelog: v2.3.0 — AI upgraded: purge_until, purge_from, summarize_ticket, mass_role, get_server_stats. Multi-key AI fallback (GROQ_API_KEY_2/3). Precise system prompt replacing vague registry dump. /purge expanded: amount/user/until/from subcommands. /ticket summarize added.

v2.2.0 — AI tools expanded: create/delete/rename channels, create/delete roles, setup ticket panels, send announcements, create giveaways, create polls. Features registry added. /features command added.
v2.1.0 — AI Assistant audit log (ai_assistant_logs table). /ailog and %ailog commands for admins.

v2.0.0 — Premium AI Assistant (/ai, %ai, no-prefix ai). 12 initial tools: ban, kick, timeout, untimeout, warn, purge, lock, unlock, slowmode, add/remove role, set nickname. Approval flow for destructive actions.
v1.x — Core moderation, economy, ticket system, giveaways, reaction roles, automod, XP/leveling, no-prefix mode.

moderation.title: Moderation
items: Ban members with optional message deletion (1-7 days) — DMs user, logs to mod-log
Kick members — logs to mod-log
Timeout (mute) members up to 28 days — supports 10m, 2h, 7d formats
Remove timeouts
Warn members — warnings persist in database, DM is sent, logged to mod-log
View all warnings per user (/warnings, %warnings)
Clear one or all warnings (/clearwarn, %clearwarn)
Unban members by user ID (/unban, %unban)

purge.title: Purge / Bulk Delete
items: /purge amount <1-100> [@user] — delete last N messages, optional user filter
/purge user @user [count] — delete a specific user's recent messages
/purge until <message_id> — delete all messages back to a message ID (14-day limit)
/purge from <message_id> — delete all messages after a message ID (14-day limit)
All four modes available as prefix commands too (%purge)

channel_management.title: Channel Management
items: Lock channels (deny @everyone SendMessages)
Unlock channels
Set slowmode 0 to 6 hours per message
Create text, voice, category, or announcement channels
Delete channels
Rename channels
Set or clear channel topics

role_management.title: Role Management
items: Create roles (name, color, hoist, mentionable)
Delete roles
Add and remove roles from individual members
mass_role: add/remove a role from all members with a given filter role (up to 150)
Set or reset member nicknames
Reaction roles — members self-assign roles by reacting to messages

tickets.title: Ticket System
items: Full ticket setup — auto-creates category and transcript channel if not configured
Post ticket panel with Open Ticket button in any channel
Each ticket creates a private channel visible only to the opener and support role
Full message transcripts auto-saved to transcript channel on close
Add or remove users from active tickets
/ticket summarize — AI reads up to 500 messages and posts an intelligent summary
View ticket system config (/ticket config)
AI can set up the full ticket system and post the panel in a single natural-language command

giveaways.title: Giveaways
items: Start giveaways with prize, duration, winner count
Optional role requirement (only members with that role can win)
Optional minimum account age filter
Bonus entries for a specific role
End, cancel, extend, or reroll giveaways
List all active giveaways in the server

polls.title: Polls
items: Create polls with a question and up to 10 options
Members vote by reacting with numbered emoji
Works in any channel the bot has access to

economy.title: Economy & Levels
items: XP earned from chatting (1 XP per message, 60s cooldown)
Levels calculated from XP — view with /rank or %rank
Coins earned from daily rewards — use /daily or %daily
Daily login streak tracked and displayed
Full profile card (/profile or %profile)
Server leaderboard (/leaderboard)

items: Word filter — define banned words/phrases
Anti-spam — auto-delete if 5+ messages in 5 seconds
Mention flood protection — configurable limit
Excessive caps detection — configurable percentage

Math calculator, color preview, translate text
8ball, coinflip, dice — fun commands
AFK mode — bot replies on mention while AFK

Reminders — set a reminder for later
Custom embed builder (/embed)

items: Custom bot prefix per server (/setprefix)
No-prefix mode — bot responds without any prefix at all
No-prefix access control — restrict no-prefix to specific roles/users
Custom embed color and footer text for server branding
Welcome messages — configured channel and custom message

ai_assistant.title: AI Assistant (Premium)
items: Natural-language commands — describe what to do and the bot executes it

27 tools: ban, kick, timeout, warn, purge (4 modes), lock/unlock, slowmode, channel CRUD, role CRUD, set nickname, mass role, send announcement, setup ticket panel, summarize ticket, create giveaway, create poll, get server stats
Approve/Cancel confirmation flow for all destructive actions (ban, kick, purge, delete, lock, announce, mass_role)
All runs recorded to an audit log — query with /ailog
Works via /ai, %ai, or no-prefix 'ai ...'

Precise system prompt with exact command docs, limits, and explicit cannot-do list

faq.q: How do I get started with the bot?
faq.a: Invite the bot, then run /setupcheck to verify all permissions and configuration. Set a mod-log channel with /logs #channel, and optionally set a custom prefix with /setprefix. That's all you need for basic moderation.

faq.q: How do I set up the ticket system?
faq.a: Run /ticket setup — the bot will auto-create a support category and transcript channel. Then run /ticket panel #your-channel to post the 'Open Ticket' button embed. Members click it to open a private ticket. Support staff need a role set via the support_role option in /ticket setup.

faq.q: How do I set up welcome messages?
faq.a: Use /welcome set channel:#welcome-channel message:Welcome {user} to {server}! Available placeholders: {user} (mention), {username}, {server}, {count} (member count). You can also set a leave message with /welcome leave.

faq.q: How do I set up reaction roles?
faq.a: Use /reactionroles add message:<message_id> emoji:⭐ role:@RoleName in the channel where the message is. Members can then react to get the role automatically. Use /reactionroles list to see all configured reaction roles.

faq.q: How do I set up the starboard?
faq.a: Starboard is a premium feature. Run /starboard setup channel:#starboard threshold:3 emoji:⭐ to configure it. When a message gets enough ⭐ reactions, it gets reposted to the starboard channel. Use /starboard status to check your current configuration.

faq.q: How do I enable no-prefix mode?
faq.a: No-prefix mode is a premium feature. Run /noprefix enable to turn it on — the bot will then respond to commands without any prefix. Use /noprefix allow role:@Role or /noprefix allow user:@User to restrict who can use no-prefix commands.

faq.q: How do I set up join-to-create (J2C) voice channels?
faq.a: J2C is premium. Create a voice channel as your 'hub', then run /j2c setup #your-hub-channel. When any member joins that channel, the bot instantly creates a private temp voice channel for them. Use {user} in the template for their name. Temp channels auto-delete when empty.

faq.q: How do I set up automod?
faq.a: Automod is premium. Use /automod enable, then configure rules: /automod words add <word> for a word filter, /automod spam to enable anti-spam, /automod caps <percent> for caps detection, /automod mentions <limit> for mention flood protection. Set a log channel with /automod logchannel #channel.

faq.q: How does the AI assistant work?
faq.a: The AI assistant (premium) lets you describe server actions in plain English. Type /ai timeout @user 1h for spamming and it will plan and execute the action. Destructive actions (ban, kick, purge) show a preview first and require you to click Approve. Use /ailog to see a history of all AI runs.

faq.q: How do I get premium?
faq.a: Contact the bot owner to activate premium for your server. Premium unlocks: AI Assistant (/ai), automod, starboard, no-prefix mode, join-to-create voice channels, and confession system.

faq.q: How do I change the bot's prefix?
faq.a: Run /setprefix <new_prefix> — for example /setprefix ! to switch to !command format. The default prefix is %. You can always use slash commands (/) regardless of the prefix.

faq.q: How does XP and leveling work?
faq.a: You earn 1 XP per message with a 60-second cooldown. Your level is automatically calculated from your XP. Use /rank to see your XP and level, /leaderboard to see the top members, and /profile for your full stats including coins and daily streak.

faq.q: How do daily rewards and coins work?
faq.a: Run /daily once per day to claim coins. Your streak increases each consecutive day you claim — higher streaks give bonus coins. Use /profile to see your total coins and current streak.

faq.q: How do I set AFK status?
faq.a: Run /afk [reason] to go AFK. The bot will reply to anyone who mentions you with your AFK reason and how long you've been away. Your AFK status is automatically removed when you send your next message.

faq.q: How do I snipe a deleted message?
faq.a: Run /snipe or %snipe in any channel to see the most recently deleted message in that channel. The snipe cache is per-channel and resets when the bot restarts.

faq.q: How do reminders work?
faq.a: Run /remind 2h Check on the giveaway to set a reminder. Supported durations: 10m, 2h, 1d, 1w etc. The bot will DM you when the time is up. Reminders survive bot restarts.

faq.q: How do giveaways work?
faq.a: Run /giveaway start and fill in prize, duration, and winner count. Optionally require a specific role, set a minimum account age, or give bonus entries to a role. The bot posts the giveaway embed and picks winners automatically when it ends. Use /giveaway reroll to pick new winners.

faq.q: How do I add users to a ticket?
faq.a: Inside an open ticket channel, run /ticket add @user to give someone access to the ticket. Use /ticket remove @user to remove them. The ticket creator and support role always have access.

faq.q: How do I view the mod log?
faq.a: First set a mod-log channel with /logs #channel. After that, all bans, kicks, timeouts, warnings, and member join/leave events are automatically sent there. Use /history @user to see a member's full moderation history.

faq.q: What permissions does the bot need?
faq.a: The bot needs Administrator permission for full functionality, or at minimum: Manage Roles, Manage Channels, Manage Messages, Ban Members, Kick Members, Moderate Members, View Channels, Send Messages, Embed Links, Read Message History, Add Reactions. Run /setupcheck to verify all permissions are correctly set.

faq.q: The bot is not responding to prefix commands. What do I do?
faq.a: Check the current prefix with /setupcheck. The default prefix is %. Make sure MESSAGE_CONTENT_INTENT_ENABLED is set to true in the bot's environment — without it, prefix commands don't work. Slash commands (/) always work regardless.

faq.q: Why is the bot not posting to the starboard?
faq.a: Check /starboard status to confirm it's enabled and the channel + emoji are set correctly. Make sure the bot has Send Messages and Embed Links permissions in the starboard channel. The reaction emoji must match exactly what's configured — custom emojis use the <:name:id> format.

faq.q: How do I set up birthdays?
faq.a: Run /birthday setchannel #channel to set where birthday announcements go. Members register their birthday with /birthday set month:12 day:25. The bot will post a birthday message on their day. You can optionally set a birthday role that gets added on the day.

faq.q: How do confession submissions work?
faq.a: Enable confessions with /confession setup channel:#confessions. Members run /confession submit and type their message anonymously. If you set a review_channel, confessions go to mods for approval first. Approved confessions are posted anonymously with a number.

faq.q: How do I use the embed builder?
faq.a: Run /embed to open an interactive embed builder. You can set title, description, color, image, and fields step by step. Use /embedtemplate to save and reuse embed designs. Templates support variables like {user}, {server}, {count} for dynamic content.

faq.q: How do I use custom commands?
faq.a: Run /customcmd add name:hello response:Hello there! to create a custom command. Members can then trigger it with %hello (or whatever the prefix is). Use /customcmd list to see all custom commands and /customcmd remove name:hello to delete one.

faq.q: What is tempban?
faq.a: Tempban (/tempban @user duration reason) bans a member for a set time then automatically unbans them. Supports durations like 1h, 12h, 7d, 2w. The unban is scheduled and survives bot restarts. The AI can also do tempbans with tempban_member.

faq.q: How do I lock down all channels at once?
faq.a: Use /lockdown to lock all text channels simultaneously. Run /lockdown unlock to restore them. This is useful during raids. Individual channels can be locked with /lock #channel.

faq.q: How do tags work?
faq.a: Tags are quick-reply snippets. Create one with /tag create name:rules content:Please read #rules. Then anyone can use /tag get name:rules to quickly post it. Useful for FAQ answers, onboarding info, or repeated announcements.

quick_start.title: Quick Start (5 minutes)
steps: Run /setupcheck — verify the bot has all required permissions
Run /logs #mod-log — set where moderation events are logged
Run /welcome set channel:#welcome — configure welcome messages (optional)
Run /setprefix ! — change prefix if you want something other than % (optional)
Done — /ban, /kick, /mute, /warn, and all slash commands are ready to use

ticket_system.title: Ticket System Setup
steps: Run /ticket setup — bot auto-creates Support category and transcript channel
Optional: /ticket setup support_role:@Support to ping your support team
Run /ticket panel #support — posts the 'Open Ticket' button in that channel
Members click the button to open a private ticket channel
Close tickets with the Close button inside the ticket — transcript saved automatically

reaction_roles.title: Reaction Roles Setup
steps: Create or find the message you want to attach roles to
Copy the message ID (right-click message → Copy Message ID)
Run /reactionroles add message:<id> emoji:🎮 role:@Gamers
Repeat for each emoji/role pair you want
Members react to get the role, unreact to remove it

starboard.title: Starboard Setup (Premium)
steps: Create a #starboard channel in your server
Run /starboard setup channel:#starboard threshold:3
Optionally change the emoji: /starboard emoji ⭐
When a message gets 3 (or your chosen threshold) star reactions, it gets posted to #starboard
Use /starboard status to check configuration, /starboard disable to pause it

j2c.title: Join-to-Create Voice Channels (Premium)
steps: Create a new voice channel named 'Create a VC' or similar
Run /j2c setup #create-a-vc template:{user}'s Channel
When a member joins that hub channel, bot instantly creates a temp voice channel for them
The member gets ownership and can manage it with /j2cpanel
The temp channel auto-deletes when everyone leaves

automod.title: AutoMod Setup (Premium)
steps: Run /automod enable to turn on automod
Run /automod logchannel #mod-log to set where violations are logged
Add bad words: /automod words add word1,word2,word3
Enable anti-spam: /automod spam (deletes if 5+ messages in 5 seconds)
Set caps limit: /automod caps 70 (deletes if 70%+ of message is caps)
Set mention limit: /automod mentions 5 (deletes if 5+ mentions in one message)

ai_assistant.title: AI Assistant Setup (Premium)
steps: Ensure GROQ_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY is set in your environment
Run /ai what can you do? to test it works
Use natural language: /ai timeout @spammer 1h for spam and delete their last 20 messages
Destructive actions (ban/kick/purge) show a preview — click Approve to confirm
View AI action history with /ailog
Add GROQ_API_KEY_2 and GROQ_API_KEY_3 for automatic fallback if credits run out

troubleshooting.bot_not_responding: Check /setupcheck for permission issues. Ensure the bot role is high enough in the role hierarchy. For prefix commands, MESSAGE_CONTENT_INTENT_ENABLED must be true.
troubleshooting.starboard_not_posting: Run /starboard status to verify it's enabled. Check the bot has Send Messages + Embed Links in the starboard channel. Confirm the emoji matches exactly (⭐ vs custom emoji format).
troubleshooting.tickets_not_opening: The bot needs Manage Channels permission. Run /ticket setup again if the category was deleted. Check the bot can see and send in the panel channel.
troubleshooting.reaction_roles_not_working: The bot needs Manage Roles permission and its role must be above the role being assigned. Use /reactionroles list to verify the setup is saved correctly.
troubleshooting.ai_not_working: Run /setupcheck and check AI status. Ensure GROQ_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY is set. If it says 'all keys exhausted', add GROQ_API_KEY_2 with a fresh key.
troubleshooting.prefix_commands_broken: Set MESSAGE_CONTENT_INTENT_ENABLED=true in your environment and restart the bot. Without this intent, the bot cannot read message content for prefix commands.
troubleshooting.j2c_not_creating_channels: The bot needs Manage Channels and Move Members permissions. Run /j2c list to confirm the hub is registered. The hub channel must be a voice channel.
troubleshooting.welcome_not_sending: Run /welcome status to check the channel is configured. Ensure the bot can Send Messages and Embed Links in the welcome channel.
